speaker: S1
text: Goal today is to lock the Q4 scope for the mobile app: offline mode, widgets, or the redesign. We can fund two.

speaker: S2
text: Support tickets say offline is the top complaint. Two hundred and twelve tickets last quarter mention losing notes on the subway.

speaker: S3
text: Widgets are cheap though. I can ship widgets in three weeks with one engineer.

speaker: S1
text: The redesign keeps slipping. If we take it on now we blow the quarter again. I want to park it until Q1.

speaker: S2
text: Agreed on parking the redesign. But offline is not small — sync conflicts alone are a month of work.

speaker: S3
text: What if offline ships in two phases? Read-only cache first, then edit-and-sync in November.

speaker: S1
text: I like phased offline. Decision: Q4 is offline phase one plus widgets. Redesign moves to Q1.

speaker: S2
text: I'll write the offline phase one spec by next Friday and get sizing from the platform team.

speaker: S3
text: And I'll draft the widget designs this week so engineering can start Monday.

speaker: S1
text: Good. I'll tell the exec team the redesign is Q1 so nobody is surprised.
